positive: The bridge exposes a Phase 3B persistence API that accepts only a ready Phase 3A bundled Full preflight result and records one immutable run-local bridge identity without re-resolving or re-projecting the pack.

The saved bridge identity retains requested and effective Full mode, network_used false, the sealed resolution receipt fingerprint, source-resolution fingerprint, project projection fingerprint, pack fingerprint, pack path, trust posture, and official source/revision/commit identity supplied by the ready preflight chain.
Unavailable, malformed, unsealed, network-using, Lite, or resolution/projection-mismatched preflight input is rejected before any bridge artifact or authority is created.
Repeated persistence of the same identity is idempotent; a different identity for the same run fails closed instead of overwriting append-only history.
Existing Standard and legacy explicit-manifest create behavior remains unchanged and the exact targeted proof selects its existing preservation test plus the new bundled_full_bridge_identity tests.
negative: Phase 3B does not wire task-start, Planning Lock, Requirements-stage lookup, MCP, host projection, packaging, schemas, registry, CLI dispatch, or documentation; those remain later Phase 3 slices.
The persistence API never invokes network access, resolver discovery, project provisioning, pack code, or Planning Lock activation and never converts blocked Full input to Lite.

The bundle resolver/projector, task-start, Planning Lock, Requirements adapter, MCP server, host adapters, schemas, manifests, registry, commands, and documentation are inspection-only or excluded from edits.
No existing bridge identity is mutated or silently replaced, and no state outside the run-local managed bridge artifact and ledger event is written.
No proof command broader than the two named unittest filters is authorized in this slice.
